title: Puducherry Government Health Insurance / Community Health Insurance pathway Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Government-supported health protection arrangements for eligible Puducherry residents under applicable health assurance programmes.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on the current Puducherry government scheme and beneficiary category; verify with the current state/UT health authority.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Puducherry Government Health Insurance / Community Health Insurance pathway.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
